rationale: The source has explicit per-dependency, first-match search, and per-package module-prefix invariants. The opaque contract exactly models the first named package, all policy aborts, the wildcard/module output sequence, and the only aggregate vector-capacity abort. Focused target-body proofs with a one-step recursive-vector lemma exceeded the package deadline at 60, 120, and 180 seconds without a counterexample.
